environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is attached to the ALB with a custom rule group containing a URI-path-based rule: the rule uses a ByteMatchStatement with SearchString '/internal/' on FieldToMatch UriPath with positional constraint STARTS_WITH, action BLOCK. Additionally, the managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet is associated with priority 1 in COUNT mode for logging. The custom blocking rule has priority 0 (highest). Note: the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet is in COUNT mode only and does NOT block requests. The DB_PASSWORD env var contains a rotated credential from AWS Secrets Manager with 1-hour TTL.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.network: ECS Fargate, no public IP, ALB is sole ingress
